newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar, Diamond Shamrock to merge.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar, Diamond Shamrock to merge.

text.p: Ultramar Corp and Diamond Shamrock Inc said on Monday they had agreed to a "merger of equals" in which each share of Diamond Shamrock will be converted into 1.02 shares of Ultramar.
The deal is expected to be accretive to earnings, the companies said.
The companies said Diamond Chairman, Chief Executive and President Roger Hemminghaus will become chairman and chief executive of the combined company, to be named Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp.
Jean Gaulin, chairman, chief executive officer and president of Ultramar, will become the new company's vice chairman, president and chief operating officer.
Gaulin will become Ultramar Diamond Shamrock's chief executive by the end of 1998 and will become chairman within three years thereafter, the companies said.
The companies said the merged company expects to pay an annual dividend of $1.10 per share, which is Ultramar's current dividend rate.
The deal is expected to result in one-time transaction costs estimated at $17 million, which will be booked in 1996, they said.
There will also be about $50 million in transition costs, most of which will be booked in 1996, they said.
They said they expect about 200 positions to be eliminated as a result of the merger, out of a combined workforce of about 17,000.

Cost savings related to the merger are projected to be about $75 million annually, with $25 million expected to be realized in 1997 and the full $75 million to be realized each year thereafter, they said.
The boards of both companies have approved the merger, which is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.
The merger is expected to close at the end of this year, they said.
The merged company, to be headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, will have an equity market value of over $2.3 billion, according to Ultramar and Diamond Shamrock.
According to a Diamond Shamrock spokesman, the market capitalization of the combined company can be broken down into $1 billion Diamond Shamrock and $1.27 billion Ultramar.
